असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह॥
englishScript:
aśraddhayā hutaṁ dattaṁ tapas taptaṁ kṛtaṁ ca yat
asad ity ucyate pārtha na ca tat pretya no iha (17.28)
translation: Whatever sacrifice, charity, or austerity is performed without faith is declared as "ASAT", O son of Pritha. It is of no value here in this world, nor in the world to come.
